{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./psfex_run_d4_shifts.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from PBS:
#   -l walltime=99:00:00      -> -t 99h
#   -l nodes=n02:ppn=02       -> request 1 node, 2 cores  (translated as -N 1 -n 1 -c 2)
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -c 2 -t 99h --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: PBS -M (email) and -m ea not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: no email notifications.

  # NOTE: PBS -N psfex_run_d4_shifts not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance unaffected.

  # NOTE: PBS -j oe (join stdout/stderr) not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: stdout/stderr handling follows Flux defaults unless configured at submission.

  module load tensorflow/2.4
  module load intel/19.0/2
  source activate new_shapepipe

  cd /home/tliaudat/github/wf-psf/ || exit 1

  flux run -n 1 -c 2 \
    python ./method-comparison/scripts/psfex_script.py \
      --repo_base_path /home/tliaudat/github/wf-psf/ \
      --saving_dir /n05data/tliaudat/wf_exps/outputs/psfex_d4_shifts/ \
      --dataset_path /n05data/tliaudat/wf_exps/datasets/psfex_shifts/ \
      --psfvar_degrees 4 \
      --psf_sampling 1. \
      --psf_size 32 \
      --run_id psfex_run_r1_d4 \
      --exec_path psfex \
      --verbose 1

  exit 0
fi
"
}
